title: Explicit span of set-multilinear polynomials vanishing under rational evaluation
author: Ivan Hu, Dieter van Melkebeek, and Andrew Morgan
work: Polynomial Identity Testing via Evaluation of Rational Functions
source_version: Theory of Computing20 (2024), Article1, publisher source publicationJuly 18, 2024; DOI10.4086/toc.2024.v020a001

source_locator.proof_scope: Selected Theorem7.4 exactly. Complete ESMVC definition, nonzero coefficient formula, vanishing proof, multi-core reduction, nonzero remainder isolation and final span proof retained in Section7; full Zoom Lemma and multilinear specialization retained. This carries a separate explicit spanning-family obligation, not a counted supporting lemma.

difficulty_reason: The statement requires constructing explicit nested-determinant set-multilinear polynomials for arbitrary variable partitions and showing they span the entire vanishing subspace. Section7 provides a separate multi-cored reduction and nonzero-remainder hitting argument using the full Zoom Lemma, so the result is not a parameter restatement or a routine restriction of the general ideal-generating theorem.
